evidence.title: OpenShaders: Shaders belong on the web

name: OpenShaders
summary: Pre-launch home for web shaders: claim a username and browse every claimed shader in an explore gallery.
description: Claim a username before launch and get a one-of-one shader generated for it. The explore page lists every claimed name with the shader it renders, newest first, with rarity filters and an immersive view; the team is building a place to publish, save and upvote shaders made in a live WebGL/WebGPU editor.
contains: explore gallery: every claimed name and the shader it renders, newest first
planned: publish, save, upvote and follow from a live WebGL/WebGPU editor
